notes.title: Patch Note v1.02
notes.notes:
Patch Note v1.02

Release Notes

[Main Menu]
- Changed the font on the main menu
- Changed  from Japanese to 日本語
- Added sound effects

[Map]
- Added a small new content to support the story
- Improved lighting
- New location for diary page 9
- Added fences and boulders around the map
- The goat now animates and...

[Gameplay]
- Disabled unnecessary keyboard keys
- Unmoveable when loading at the entrance now
- Papers outside are now easily seen
- Fixed floating pages
- Character's height slightly adjusted (exterior)
- Disabled tilt shift
- Disabled motion blur

More fixes and additional contents coming.
Thank you for your patience.

notes.title: Patch note v1.01
notes.notes:
Release Notes for Evie v1.01

- Fixed page numbers

- Added keyboard & mouse control map in the main menu

- Added a new quality setting for low-end PCs

- Added a static goat (watching you)

- Slightly easier to see the diary papers now

- Diary page 15 moved a bit

We didn't fix all the known bugs, yet.
We are trying our best to fix as much as possible.
Thank you for your patience.
